page.text:
Common sense for Contra Costa
# Frese For Congress
Make California affordable. Better schools. Safer streets. Common sense.
Donate
Join the Digital Door Knockers
Instagram
X
Facebook
Reddit
YouTube
TikTok
Can't give money? Post in your town's Facebook and Nextdoor groups. That's the whole ask.
# Help this campaign without spending a dime
I'm not asking for a check. I'm not asking you to knock on doors.One party has run California for fifteen years. Housing, gas, groceries, schools. Are you better off? They win because most people never hear there's another choice. You can fix that from your phone.1. Join the Digital Door Knockers. It's door knocking from your couch. Every so often I email you a post for your town's Facebook and Nextdoor groups. You copy it, paste it, and answer the comments in your own words. One paste reaches more living rooms than a Saturday of canvassing.
2. Follow, like, comment, repost. Every one puts a post in front of your neighbors.
3. Vote, and bring people with you. Some House races come down to a few hundred votes. Fill out your ballot the day it arrives, then get your friends, family, and church to do the same.Everyone says they want money out of politics. Here's your chance to prove it. No PACs, no big donors, no consultants. A campaign that isn't bought can't be sold.
Join the Digital Door Knockers
Nobody should get rich, or grow old, running your government
## Clean Up Congress
Congress was never meant to be a career, and you certainly shouldn’t get rich from it. You should be there to serve. The career grifters have turned it into a job with a pension, and the outcome for you stopped mattering a long time ago.- 8-year term limits. Congress was never meant to be a career.
- Ban members of Congress from trading stocks.
- No budget, no pay.
- Close the revolving door. No cashing out as a lobbyist.
California shouldn’t be the hardest place in America to afford a life
## Affordability
Congress makes the budget and spends the money. They print and devalue your dollar and inflate assets, and every year a home gets further out of reach. Most Americans now live paycheck to paycheck. The American dream is slipping away, and Congress did that. Owning a home here shouldn’t feel impossible, and raising a family here shouldn’t feel like a luxury.- Stop the deficit spending that drives up mortgage rates and prices.
- Cut the red tape that makes building slow and expensive.
- Ban Wall Street and hedge funds from buying single-family homes.
- Block foreign ownership of American farmland and family homes.
Safe streets aren’t partisan. They’re the baseline
## Safety
Every neighborhood in this district should feel safe after dark.- Back the police. Prosecute crime.
- End cashless bail. Consequences can't be optional.
- Keep repeat offenders off the streets.
- Get fentanyl off our streets. Real consequences for dealers.
- Keep boys out of girls' sports. My opponent voted no. Twice.
- Parents have a right to see what their kids are taught. He voted no on that too.
Trust in elections is foundational. Without it, nothing else works
## Election Integrity
Voting should be easy to participate in and hard to manipulate. Keep vote by mail. Make Election Day a holiday so anyone who wants to vote in person can, and show ID when you do.- Make Election Day a national holiday.
- Voter ID for federal elections.
- Same-day voting with ID. Keep vote by mail.
- Paper ballots as the permanent audit trail.
- Transparent, auditable results voters can trust.
Schools should teach. That’s the whole job
## Education
Schools should prepare kids for real life, not just more bureaucracy.- No federal income tax on teachers.
- Money to classrooms, not bureaucrats.
- Back to basics: reading, math, history and civics.
- Bring back shop class and the trades.
- Prepare kids for automation and AI.
- Parents in charge.
You paid into it your whole life. It’s yours
## Social Security & Medicare
You worked for it. Washington doesn’t get to touch it.- No cuts. You earned it.
- No raising the retirement age.
- Invest part of the trust fund in the S&P 500. Done in the 1980s, it would run a surplus today.
- Go after the fraud and waste. Benefits for Americans who paid in.
## A Different Focus
## My focus is families in Contra Costa, Castro Valley, Ashland and San Leandro, and the things that actually hit your life: your kids' schools, your safety, your bills, your job, and the retirement you were promised. My opponent has had eleven years, 204 bills, and two laws to show for it. For him it's about the income. For me it's about the outcome.Husband. Father. Coach. Small business owner. 49ers fan. Moraga. I'm not a politician. I built a national snack brand from my own kitchen, sold it, and have run consumer companies since. I've made payroll and answered to customers, not donors. I don't need this as a job.Endorsed by: Steve Hilton · Contra Costa Republican Party · Alameda County Republican Party · Carl DeMaio's Reform California · Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association PAC · BAJC-Action (Bay Area Jewish Coalition) · CRPA PAC

Frese For Congress collects only what you give us: your name, email, phone number, and ZIP code when you sign up, volunteer, or donate. We use it to send campaign updates, coordinate volunteers, and answer your messages. We do not sell or rent your information to anyone.Text messages: if you give us your number or text us, you may receive campaign texts from Frese For Congress. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to any message to opt out, or HELP for help.Text messaging opt-in data, consent and related collected personal information will not be shared with or sold to any third parties, unless required by law.No mobile information will be shared by us with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties unless required by law. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is used, contact Frese For Congress at freseforcongress.com, [email protected], or (925) 222-5416.You can ask us to delete your information at any time by emailing [email protected].Paid for by Frese For Congress.
